login.title: Sign in to MyMob
login.intro: Portals for Elders, clinics and services. We'll text you a code.
login.demoNote: Demo: seeded numbers 0400 000 001–099 accept the code 123456. Codes also appear in the admin outbox.

home.pick: Choose where you'd like to work today.
home.appOnly: Your account uses the MyMob app. There's no web portal for your role yet.
home.elderBody: Approve members, posts and services, and see how the hub is used.
home.providerBody: Invite patients, book appointments and see attendance insights.
home.adminBody: Verify Elder nominations, onboard providers, see the outbox and audit log.

elder.subtitle: Elder portal
elder.joinRequestsHint: People asking to join. Young people need a parent or guardian's consent first.
elder.noneWaiting: Nothing waiting. You're all caught up.
elder.providerRequests: Services asking to reach the group
elder.providerRequestsHint: Approved services can post events here. They never see the group feed.
elder.recentPostsHint: Posts go up straight away. Remove anything that isn't right for the community.
elder.reportedHint: Members flagged these for you to check.
elder.pinnedHint: Shown at the top of everyone's feed.
elder.auntyHint: A chatbot that yarns one-to-one with members. It is off until you turn it on.
elder.auntyEnable: Let our mob yarn with an AI Aunty
elder.auntyEnableHint: She is a computer, not an Elder, and she says so. She will not share cultural knowledge or give health advice.
elder.auntyGuidance: What should she know about yarning with your mob?
elder.auntyGuidanceHint: In your own words. This goes to her before every yarn, and it overrides her default instructions.
elder.auntyGuidancePlaceholder: e.g. Send anyone asking about sorry business to Aunty Grace. Don't talk about the old mission. Our clinic day is Tuesday.
elder.auntyPrivacy: Yarns are private. You decide whether there is an Aunty and what she is told, but you cannot read anyone's conversation — and neither can we.
elder.membersHint: Removing someone stops them seeing the group. They can ask to join again.
elder.name: Name
elder.nominateHint: A partner organisation verifies new Elders before the role is active.
elder.dataHint: The community owns its data. Export it at any time. Health appointments are never included: they belong to each person.
elder.deletionNote: Deletion requests go to the MyMob custodian team.
elder.vsFourWeeks: Last full week vs 4 weeks earlier
elder.weeklyActiveHint: Members who opened MyMob at least once that week.
elder.topEventsHint: Past events ranked by people going.
elder.liveQuery: Live query over SQL views on this community's data only.
elder.gapTitle: Which communities are far from the services they need?
elder.gapHint: Distance and rough travel time from each community to the nearest verified service of each type.

provider.subtitle: Clinic portal
provider.inviteHint: They accept in the MyMob app. People without the app still get SMS reminders.
provider.mobileHint: Reminders never say what the appointment is for: phones are often shared.
provider.patientsHint: Linked by the patient's own consent. They can withdraw it at any time.
provider.bookHint: The patient gets a notice now, then reminders 48 hours and 2 hours before. Their nominated carers are reminded too.
provider.transportPlaceholder: e.g. Community bus leaves the store at 9:15am
provider.booked: Booked. The patient has been notified.
provider.upcomingHint: Reminders go by push, or SMS when someone has no app or push didn't arrive.
provider.auditNote: Every view of appointment data by staff is recorded in the audit log.
provider.groupsHint: Elders decide whether your service can post events to their group. You never see the group's feed.
provider.defaultRequest: We'd like to share health events and clinic days with the community.
provider.postEventHint: Only to groups whose Elders approved your service.
provider.needApproval: No group has approved your service yet.
provider.carerAttendance: Attendance when a carer is also reminded
provider.dnaTrend: Where and when are patients missing appointments?
provider.dnaTrendHint: Did-not-attend rate, rolling 4 weeks. Gaps are windows with fewer than 5 appointments.
provider.reminderEffectHint: Attendance by the strongest reminder each appointment received.
provider.deidentified: De-identified aggregates from live SQL views. Any group smaller than 5 shows as "<5". Seeded demo data: these illustrate hypotheses, not findings.

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.subtitle: Admins can't read health data. Every access is logged.
admin.nominationsHint: In production a partner organisation (e.g. an ACCHO or Land Council) verifies these.
admin.providersHint: Only verified providers can invite patients or ask to reach a group.
admin.onboardHint: Creates a verified provider and a staff login for the given mobile.
admin.outboxHint: Every SMS and push MyMob sent. While AWS SNS and APNs are mocked, messages land here instead of on a phone.
admin.auditHint: Decisions, exports and every staff read of appointment data.

languages.title: Community languages
languages.intro: Translate MyMob into your community's languages. Each language belongs to its community: Elders and the language custodians they appoint write it, and only Elders approve and publish. Anything not yet translated shows in English.
languages.none: No languages yet. An Elder can add one.
languages.progress: {approved} of {total} approved · {draft} waiting for an Elder
languages.addLanguageHint: Only add a language with the community's agreement, and check the code with your language centre.
languages.name: Name in English
languages.nameHint: How English speakers refer to it
languages.codeHint: ISO 639-3 code (AUSTLANG lists them), optionally with a region, e.g. abc-AU. Use qaa–qtz for a local variety without a code.
languages.notesPlaceholder: Spelling conventions, words to avoid, who to ask
languages.elderNote: As an Elder you can approve strings and publish. Published languages appear in everyone's language menu, on the web and in the app.
languages.custodianNote: Your translations are saved as drafts. An Elder approves them before anyone else sees them.
languages.importHint: Upload a file exported from here, filled in offline. Everything comes in as drafts for Elder review.
